case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Franz Stadler,

Thank you for your proposal and the terms offered for the requested volume. Your emphasis on comprehensive product coverage fits our aim to consolidate the kit with one distributor.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09).

Our analysis supports an ambitious bundle price in exchange for consolidated demand and a longer commitment, giving you a clear case for pricing approval. We are flexible on payment terms, with Option B retaining your quoted terms; please choose the package that works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.20 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.14 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 5.15 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement.

We look forward to building on our relationship, with an expanded award subject to confirmed full-kit coverage and a credible delivery plan.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We welcome the opportunity to consolidate this kit and acknowledge the verified volume increase. 

Based on your preference for a 24-month agreement and maintaining the 30-day payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €5.51 per unit. This reflects the economies of scale from the increased volume while ensuring we can maintain our high service levels and reliable delivery. Our Angebot provides a price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Franz Stadler,

Thank you for reducing the price to reflect the verified volume increase; your point that a binding award supports better pricing is fair. Our proposal is based on the annual kit volume in your schedule, subject to confirmed full-kit coverage and a credible delivery plan.

We are taking a modest price step and expect further movement in return, with the consolidated award and longer commitment supporting your pricing case. We are flexible on payment terms, and Option B retains your current terms; please tell us which package works best. We can commit to over 24 months, as set out in the term sheets.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.30 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.23 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 5.25 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement.

Thank you for working through this with us—hopefully the kit will soon have fewer loose ends than the negotiation.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
